premise: Gallimimus wins every race in a flash on her long legs — so fast it's never any fun — so she invents the slowest race to the lagoon: she tiptoes, Pachycephalosaurus can't keep still and bounces in first, and Turtle wins without even trying.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Tortoise and the Hare' upside down: a race to be slowest, and the tortoise wins by being herself.
lesson: The fun is in the playing, not the winning.
learning: Gallimimus could run very fast on its long legs, like an ostrich.

en-US.title: The Slowest Race
en-US.text: {gallimimus:enter} Gallimimus had two long legs, like an ostrich, and she was the fastest runner in the valley. {gallimimus:face happy} Every race was over in a flash. {sfx:zip} Zip! She'd won again. {gallimimus:face sad} [sighs] And that was no fun at all. So she had an idea. "The SLOWEST race! To the lagoon! Last one there wins!" {pachycephalosaurus:enter} {pachycephalosaurus:go to gallimimus} Pachycephalosaurus and {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to gallimimus} Turtle wanted to play. {gallimimus:live ready-set hold} "Ready, steady," {gallimimus:live ready-set resume} "go-o-o!" {gallimimus:go to lagoon by walk} {sfx:tiptoe} Gallimimus tiptoed. {pachycephalosaurus:live bounce} But Pachycephalosaurus couldn't keep still. He bounced and he bounced, {pachycephalosaurus:go to lagoon by run} all the way to the lagoon. {pachycephalosaurus:face surprised} "Oops! First!" Gallimimus came second, on very slow tiptoes. {turtle:go to lagoon} And Turtle? Turtle crawled. Step. And step. And a little rest. {gallimimus:live tap-foot} Gallimimus tapped her foot, tap, tap, tap. "Hurry up, Turtle!" {gallimimus:face happy} Then she laughed. "No! Slow DOWN!" At last, very last of all, Turtle arrived. [excited] Turtle WINS! {all:face happy} {all:hop x2} Everyone cheered, and Turtle, smiling, did a slow, slow {turtle:live slow-dance} victory dance. [happily] "Best race ever," said Gallimimus. "It took all afternoon!"

es-ES.title: La carrera más lenta
es-ES.text: {gallimimus:enter} Gallimimus tenía dos patas largas, como un avestruz, y era la más rápida del valle. {gallimimus:face happy} Todas las carreras se acababan en un suspiro. {sfx:zip} ¡Zas! Había vuelto a ganar. {gallimimus:face sad} [sighs] Y así no tenía gracia. Entonces se le ocurrió una idea. —¡La carrera MÁS LENTA! ¡Hasta la laguna! ¡Gana el último! {pachycephalosaurus:enter} {pachycephalosaurus:go to gallimimus} Paquicefalosaurio y {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to gallimimus} Tortuga se apuntaron. {gallimimus:live ready-set hold} —Preparados, listos… {gallimimus:live ready-set resume} ¡yaaa! {gallimimus:go to lagoon by walk} {sfx:tiptoe} Gallimimus fue de puntillas. {pachycephalosaurus:live bounce} Pero Paquicefalosaurio no podía estarse quieto: botando, {pachycephalosaurus:go to lagoon by run} botando, llegó hasta la laguna. {pachycephalosaurus:face surprised} —¡Uy! ¡El primero! Gallimimus llegó la segunda, de puntillas. {turtle:go to lagoon} ¿Y Tortuga? Tortuga caminaba. Un pasito. Otro pasito. Y un descansito. {gallimimus:live tap-foot} Gallimimus tamborileaba con el pie, tap, tap, tap. —¡Corre, Tortuga! {gallimimus:face happy} —Y se echó a reír—. ¡No, no! ¡Más DESPACIO! Por fin, la última de todas, llegó Tortuga. [excited] ¡Tortuga GANA! {all:face happy} {all:hop x2} Todos la vitorearon, y Tortuga, muy sonriente, se marcó un {turtle:live slow-dance} bailecito lento, lentísimo. [happily] —¡La mejor carrera del mundo! —dijo Gallimimus—. ¡Ha durado toda la tarde!

zip.prompt: a quick comic whoosh of someone running past very fast, playful
